patch_description: This scheduler uses a different budget-based policy: clone is the default reserve, and mutation probability is treated as a scarce ecological “spend” released only when population stress, parent reproductive leverage, and operator evidence agree. Stable worlds accumulate a strong no-spend lock, while post-injury decline can open a narrow standard/conservative rescue channel. Evidence affects both trust and fatigue, so successful underused operators can be tried under stress without broad fixed mutation.
